name: Down South BBQ
description: Down South Barbecue is located between Foley and Gulf Shores, Alabama, right on the way to the Alabama Beach. We serve the best barbecue on the coast from our family-size umbrella covered tables. Now serving breakfast! Drop by and eat your lunch or supper. After a long drive to the beach, don't worry about cooking! Let Mama relax. Get a complete meal for all your family. Great food at a fair price. We cater for big orders - call ahead so we have time to properly prepare the very best Southern Barbecue for your group!
